title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-07-12

ai_review.summary: Audience‑recorded Fillmore East show with lo‑fi but listenable sound captures a spectacular Pigpen‑heavy performance, highlighted by Turn On Your Lovelight and Attics of My Life.
ai_review.review: The July 1970 Fillmore East set is praised as one of the band’s most magical nights – a midnight acoustic Pigpen showcase followed by an electric marathon that includes standout renditions of “Turn On Your Lovelight,” “Attics of My Life,” and a tight “Tighten Up” jam.  Although the tape is an audience recording with occasional muffled sections, uneven speed and hand‑clap ambience, listeners find it more than adequate to relive the night’s energy.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently enthusiastic reviews praise the musical performance (many 5‑star comments) while noting only moderate recording flaws, yielding a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Loud lobby ambience and hand‑clapping; occasional muffled sections and uneven tape speed make some parts hard to hear, but overall the recording is listenable with EQ/headphones.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Midnight acoustic Pigpen set leads into a New Riders interlude (Garcia on steel) and then a high‑energy electric second set; the pacing is praised as magical and keeps the audience engaged through dawn.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned playing steel guitar with the New Riders and noted the band was “dosed” like him.
band_member_comments.Drums: Hart on drums is highlighted during the New Riders segment.
